profile.summaryLine: Marcus is a 35-year-old man with multiple complex health conditions who shares his phone and values privacy about his diagnoses in text messages.

emotionalContext.text: Marcus shares his phone and is concerned about privacy regarding his health conditions in text messages.
emotionalContext.reason: He explicitly stated this in his check-in.

emotionalContext.text: Marcus has a history of complex and chronic medical conditions, which may contribute to stress or fatigue.
emotionalContext.reason: Multiple serious diagnoses often impact emotional well-being.

emotionalContext.text: Marcus is currently unemployed, which may affect his sense of security or self-esteem.
emotionalContext.reason: Unemployment is documented in the record.

privacyRules.rule: Do not include any diagnosis names or medication names related to HIV, kidney disease, or opportunistic infections in SMS messages.
privacyRules.reason: Marcus stated his phone is shared and does not want his conditions named in texts.

strengths.text: Marcus is proactive in communicating his privacy needs to the care team.
strengths.reason: He clearly stated his preferences regarding privacy.

strengths.text: Marcus has maintained engagement with multiple specialty clinics over several years.

dataQualityWarnings: No explicit documentation of preferred time of day for communication.
No documentation of cognitive impairment or need for cognitive support.
"HIV-related opportunistic skin infection" appears as both a primary diagnosis and a comorbidity.
